lines.japanese: 「んんんっ、んっ、んぐっ、ぐっ……うぅむ……」
lines.english: “Mmmnh, ngh, nnngh, gh… Mmm…”

lines.japanese: 幾度も喉を突かれる。
lines.english: Something jabs at her throat again and again.

lines.japanese:
「んんっ、んぐ、ぐっ……んふ……
　ふわぁ……んむむっ！」
lines.english: “Nnnh, ngh, gh… nnf… Hwah… mmmph!”

lines.japanese:
男の乱暴な行為。
　千鳥は涙と涎を垂らして相手を睨む。
lines.english: The man's brutal act. Tears and saliva streaming down her face, Chidori glares at him.

lines.japanese: 「んんんぅぅ……う……んん……んむ……」
lines.english: “Mmmnn… uh… nn… mmph…”

lines.japanese: しかし、遠い。
lines.english: Yet it all feels far away.

lines.japanese: 男は能力で、脳内をいじっていた。
lines.english: The man is using his ability to tamper with her brain.

lines.japanese:
「……おぉ……あっ、……はんっ……
　んんっ、んっ……んぅぅ……」
lines.english: “…Oh… ah… hah… nnnh, ngh… mmm…”

lines.japanese: 会話のない、絞り出される声だけの行為。
lines.english: An act without words, accompanied only by sounds wrung from her throat.

lines.japanese: 「王は接収する」
lines.english: “The king is to be requisitioned.”

lines.japanese: 突然呼ばれた自分の名が、遠い。
lines.english: His own name, spoken without warning, sounded distant.

lines.japanese: 「あれは、有用だ」
lines.english: “It is useful.”

lines.japanese: 「たとえ予備であっても」
lines.english: “Even if only as a reserve.”

lines.japanese:
「しかし……んっ……
　あれ、はっ……不安定……で……」
lines.english: “But… ngh… it's… unstable…”

lines.japanese: 激しく指を突き込む。
lines.english: He drives his fingers in hard.

lines.japanese: 「んむぅっ！」
lines.english: “Mmmph!”

lines.japanese: 「情報を明け渡せ」
lines.english: “Surrender the information.”

lines.japanese: 激しく指を突き込む。
lines.english: He drives his fingers in hard.

lines.japanese: 「んんっっ！　んうっ！」
lines.english: “Nnnnh! Nngh!”

lines.japanese: 「このような『画策色』を隠し通していたか、貴様」
lines.english: “So you kept the ‘color’ of this scheme hidden all this time, did you?”

lines.japanese: 頬を握り込み、更に指を突き込む。
lines.english: He grips her cheek and pushes his fingers in deeper.

lines.japanese: 「ぐうっ、んんんっ、あっ、んむむっっ！」
lines.english: “Ghh, nnnnh, ah, mmmph!”

lines.japanese:
千鳥の口は塞がれたまま、うめき声を排出するだ
けだ。
lines.english: With Chidori's mouth still blocked, nothing escapes but muffled groans.

lines.japanese: 「うあっ！　あっ、くっ、はんッ！　んんんッ！」
lines.english: “Ah! Ah, ngh, hah! Nnnnh!”

lines.japanese: 「やはり女か……そのようなことを」
lines.english: “A woman after all… To think you would do such a thing.”

lines.japanese:
……灰野の能力は謎が多い。
　黎明期出身の、忍の先達である。
lines.english: …Much about Haino's abilities remained a mystery. He was Shinobu's predecessor, a survivor from the earliest days.

lines.japanese:
未分化の時代を抜けた人物であり、突発的な
変異・変性によって、途方もない奇形の力を身につ
けている可能性が高い。
lines.english: He had come through an age before abilities were differentiated. A sudden mutation or alteration had likely endowed him with some monstrously aberrant form of power.

lines.japanese:
その一つはどうやら、対象との粘膜接触による情報
のローディングであるようだ。
lines.english: One of those powers appeared to load information through mucosal contact with a target.

lines.japanese: いみじくも千鳥と同様の能力である。
lines.english: Remarkably, it was the same ability Chidori possessed.

lines.japanese: 「よく欺き通した」
lines.english: “You kept up the deception well.”

lines.japanese:
今までどれだけの間……千鳥はそれを秘匿してき
たのだろう。
lines.english: How long… had Chidori kept it hidden?

lines.japanese:
感情もろとも記憶を封じ、ただ達成するためだけ
の機械であった千鳥だ。
lines.english: She had sealed away her memories along with her emotions, becoming nothing but a machine intent on achieving its purpose.

lines.japanese: だが今、彼女はすべてを取り戻してしまった。
lines.english: But now she had recovered everything.

lines.japanese: 侵略に対抗できない。
lines.english: She could not resist the invasion.

lines.japanese: 「ぐうっ、んんんっ、んむむっっ！」
lines.english: “Ghh, nnnnh, mmmph!”

lines.japanese:
「さて、罰を与えねばならないわけだが……貴様に
　も、知られて恥ずかしい事柄があるだろう」
lines.english: “Now, punishment is called for… But surely there are things even you would be ashamed to have anyone know.”

lines.japanese: まったく感情のない口調。
lines.english: His voice is utterly devoid of emotion.

lines.japanese: 「全て、引き出してやろう」
lines.english: “I will pull every one of them out.”

lines.japanese: 疲憊していた千鳥の身体が、脈打った。
lines.english: Chidori's exhausted body throbs.

lines.japanese: 「な、なにを……？」
lines.english: “W-what are you…?”

lines.japanese: 「わかるはずだ。自分が、読み出される感覚が」
lines.english: “You must feel it—the sensation of yourself being read out.”

lines.japanese: 灰野が更に深々と挿入した。
lines.english: Haino drives his fingers still deeper.

lines.japanese: 「んむぅっ！」
lines.english: “Mmmph!”

lines.japanese: 嗚咽に似た悲鳴。
lines.english: A scream like a sob.

lines.japanese: 「んんっっ！　んうっ！」
lines.english: “Nnnnh! Nngh!”

lines.japanese: 苦痛と屈辱にまみれていく。
lines.english: Pain and humiliation engulf her.

lines.japanese: 「ぐうっ、んんんっ、あっ、んむむっっ！」
lines.english: “Ghh, nnnnh, ah, mmmph!”

lines.japanese:
突き動かされる千鳥は、もはや完全に理性を失っ
ている。
lines.english: Under the relentless assault, Chidori has lost all reason.

lines.japanese: 肉体の刺激に、鈍い反応を返すだけの存在だ。
lines.english: She is reduced to a thing that offers only dull responses to physical stimulation.

lines.japanese:
抗することも忘れ、ただ怯えている。
　まともに対応すれば、善戦には持ち込めたかも知
れない。
lines.english: She has forgotten even to resist and knows only fear. Had she been capable of a coherent response, she might have put up a worthy fight.

lines.japanese: 一度崩れれば、人はたやすく性能を失う。
lines.english: Once broken, a person readily loses the ability to function.

lines.japanese: 千鳥はもう、機械ではなくなったためだ。
lines.english: Because Chidori is no longer a machine.

lines.japanese: （奪われる）
lines.english: (She'll be taken from me.)

lines.japanese: それを許してしまうのか？
lines.english: Would he allow it?

lines.japanese: （奪われる）
lines.english: (She'll be taken from me.)

lines.japanese: 未完成の個体、その誤りの故に。
lines.english: An unfinished specimen. Because of that error.

lines.japanese: （聖域は）
lines.english: (The sanctuary…)

lines.japanese:
健全な人としての領域に、とどまって滅びるのも
一興。
lines.english: There was a certain appeal in staying within the bounds of a healthy human life, even if it meant perishing there.

lines.japanese: もとより可能性はないのだから。
lines.english: There had been no chance from the start.

lines.japanese:
人に生存の道は、残されていない。
　可能性は、０。
　ずっとそう思ってきた。いや。
lines.english: No path to survival remained for humanity. Probability: zero. He had always believed that. No—

lines.japanese:
事実、そうなのだ。
　ただ……たどる過程には、違いをつけることはで
きるかも知れない。
lines.english: It was the truth. Still… perhaps a different course could be taken along the way.

lines.japanese:
本当に全てをなげうつことで、いくらかの小さな
結果を得られる可能性。
lines.english: If he truly threw everything away, there was a chance of achieving some small result.

lines.japanese:
その鍵は、ある。
　深い場所にある。
　第一階層へと沈殿していく勇気さえあれば。
lines.english: The key existed. It lay somewhere deep. If only he had the courage to sink into the First Stratum.
